pairs.why: A is a chunky, saturated cartoon vehicle with a character-like face, like the taxi; B is a plain white box on gray moon ground and looks flat and generic.
A's target has a white outer rim like the real one, and its bear is smooth; B gives the target a blue outer ring and the bear a fuzzy, textured surface.
B's brighter yellow blades and crisp dark insert are closer to the real fins; A's blades turn an orange gradient and look softer and more toy-like.
B is built like a real calculator, with numbered keys and cyan operator keys showing their symbols; A's keys are blank, so it reads as a toy block.
B matches the real card's flat, light-blue controller with many small buttons, knobs and faders; A is an oversized, puffy toy.
A fills the frame with a large, saturated, glossy glass like the real card; B's glass is small, finely detailed and more photographic.
B's glossy blue shells and smooth cream drumhead on a lit red stage are slightly closer; A's bass drum head has a scratched, textured look.
A's rounder, fuller tiers of soft leaves are closer to the real topiary; B's leaves are sharper, more yellow-green and texture-heavy, the fault the lessons mark down.
